title: CORE-7132 · SHARED: reviews carousel inactive dot renders flat grey, not live's translucent #333
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7132](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7132)

## Verified 2026-08-25 — reproduces

Live's inactive carousel dot is **`#333` at 25% opacity** — a translucent dark dot. The clone
used a flat, fully opaque grey token. Measured headed at 360 on `/` (dots only render once a
track overflows, so they are a mobile-width control):

| | live | clone (before) |
|---|---|---|
| inactive dot | `rgb(51,51,51)` · **opacity 0.25** | `rgb(199,199,199)` · **opacity 1** |
| active dot | `rgb(0,177,227)` · opacity 1 | `rgb(0,177,227)` · opacity 1 ✅ |
| size / margin | 10px / 10px | 10px / 10px ✅ |
| radius | 30px | 9999px — both fully round ✅ |

Live's rule, from its own stylesheet:

```css
.Carousel--carousel__dotgroup button        { background:#333; opacity:.25; ... }
.Carousel--carousel__dotgroup button[disabled] { background:#00b1e3; opacity:1 }
```

Everything except the inactive tone already matched, including all four dot groups at the
same scroll positions.

## Why it is worth fixing, given the colours are close

Composited over white, live's dot resolves to `rgb(204,204,204)` against the clone's
`rgb(199,199,199)` — 5/255, near the threshold of perception. **The real difference is the
compositing model:** live's dot is translucent and picks up whatever sits behind it, the
clone's is opaque and never does. On any non-white section the two diverge visibly, and the
clone would need a second hard-coded grey per background to keep up.

Matching live's `#333 / 25%` makes the dot correct on every backdrop by construction.

## After

All four dot groups on `/` at 360, on the production build of this branch:

| | value |
|---|---|
| inactive | `rgb(51,51,51)` · **opacity 0.25** — exact match with live |
| active | `rgb(0,177,227)` · opacity 1 — unchanged |

![before/after](https://60cfqkpecvp2z01z.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/pr-screenshots/core-7132/dots-before-after.png)

**BEFORE** = `rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app` (`main`) · **AFTER** = local production build of this branch. Dots shown at 3x.

> The Vercel preview could not be used: it is SSO-walled and returns `<title>Login – Vercel</title>` with **HTTP 200**, so an automated screenshot of it captures a login page rather than the app.

## Scope

`SnapCarousel` is shared by `ReviewRatings`, `UniqueSellingPoints`, `WhyChooseUs`,
`FourSteps` and `ChooseCompanyStructure` — one change covers every dot on the site, which is
what the ticket's SHARED tag asks for.

`opacity-100` is added to `dotActive` so the active dot is unaffected by the new base
opacity; verified it still renders fully opaque cyan.

## Checks

- `bun run ts` clean · `bun run build` green
- all 4 dot groups on `/` measured before and after at 360
acceptanceCriteria: Inactive dot renders rgb(51,51,51) at opacity 0.25, matching live exactly.
Active dot stays rgb(0,177,227) at full opacity.
Size, margin and roundness unchanged (10px / 10px / fully round).
Applies to every SnapCarousel user, not just the reviews track.
